data.title: Mitgliedsbeitrag 2026 – Erinnerung (Membership fee 2026 – reminder)
data.summary: Sportverein Beispielau 1911 e.V. writes that the direct debit for the 2026 family membership fee was returned by the bank, and asks for payment of €172.50 (the €168.00 annual fee plus a €4.50 return-debit fee) by 3 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your sports club's attempt to collect the 2026 family membership fee by direct debit (Lastschrift) failed and was sent back by your bank, so they are now asking you to transfer the outstanding amount yourself. Pay the €172.50 to the club's account by 3 December 2026. If your bank details have changed, send them a new SEPA mandate instead of relying on the old one. If you miss the deadline, the club may try to collect again or take further steps to recover the money, though this letter does not say exactly what.
